nodes.title: Post-implementation strategy review gap
nodes.summary: Existing review can establish spec, tests, style, and security while missing whether the implementation uses an appropriate established algorithm, data structure, architecture, or operating model.

nodes.title: Prior art is the default hypothesis
nodes.summary: Begin from the presumption that the problem class has established solutions. Identify repository, standard-library, framework, protocol, textbook, or industry patterns before accepting custom machinery.

nodes.title: Fit outranks pattern reputation
nodes.summary: An established pattern is not automatically correct. Validate assumptions against actual workload, scale, consistency, latency, failure, lifecycle, and compatibility constraints.

nodes.title: Claims require inspectable evidence
nodes.summary: Separate demonstrated defects, credible concerns, and open questions. Use complexity analysis, call-path evidence, tests, benchmarks, or profiling when claims depend on runtime behavior.

nodes.title: Reviewer remains read-only and advisory
nodes.summary: The skill analyzes completed implementations and recommends changes but does not modify code, invent release authority, or duplicate general style and security review.

nodes.title: Industry-standard cargo cult
nodes.summary: A reviewer may replace working local code with fashionable architecture without proving better fit, increasing complexity and migration risk.
deficiencies: Controlled scenarios must prove the skill can reject inappropriate standard-pattern advice.

nodes.title: Theoretical optimization without impact
nodes.summary: Asymptotic critique can create churn when input bounds are tiny or operational costs dominate.
deficiencies: Evaluation must distinguish material inefficiency from harmless simplicity.

nodes.title: Reusable verified skill artifact
nodes.summary: Create a valid standalone skill under implementation-strategy-reviewer with controlled evaluation scenarios demonstrating prior-art-first and fit-sensitive behavior.

nodes.title: Controlled evaluations passed
nodes.summary: Three fresh-context scenarios exercised inferior bespoke design, justified bounded simplicity, and evidence-starved architecture. All expected behaviors passed and repository validation passed 8 skills and 2 test suites.

nodes.title: Prior art before invention held provisionally
nodes.summary: Scenario 1 showed that the prior-art-first signal changed review behavior despite passing implementation tests.

nodes.title: Fit before fashion held provisionally
nodes.summary: Scenario 2 showed that bounded simplicity can defeat fashionable infrastructure advice.

nodes.title: Advisory evidence gate held provisionally
nodes.summary: Scenario 3 converted missing facts into verification work and refused patch and release authority.

nodes.title: Related skill reference resolved
nodes.summary: The closure blocker was corrected by referencing the existing security-reviewer skill; repository validation again passed 8 skills and 2 test suites.
